senses.gloss:
सौगन्धिक

SAUGANDHIKA . A flower-garden of kubera. It is assumed that vāyu (the wind-god) carried fragrance from this garden and remained in the palace of kubera, praising him. This garden was full of sweet-scented lotus (saugandhika-flower). (M.B. Sabhā Parva, Chapter, 10).

सौगन्धिकवन

SAUGANDHIKAVANA . A holy place. It is assumed, that the gods such as brahmā and others, hermits, Siddhas, Cāraṇas, Gandharvas, kinnaras, Big Nāgas, and so on dwell in this place. All the sins of a man are washed away, the moment he visits this holy place. (M.B. Vana Parva, Chapter 34, Stanza 4).
